faq_how_it_works_a: The app helps you learn new words in your target language by providing a daily set of words to practice. You can mark words as learned, and the app tracks your progress over time.
faq_progress_tracking_q: How does the app track my progress?
faq_progress_tracking_a: The app tracks the number of words you learn each day. Your daily progress is displayed on the home page, and streaks are calculated when you hit your daily target.
faq_missed_day_q: What happens if I miss a day?
faq_missed_day_a: If you miss a day, your streak will pause. You can continue learning the next day, and your progress will still be tracked from then.
faq_incomplete_words_q: What if I don't learn all my words for the day?
faq_incomplete_words_a: Any words you don't learn will go back into the pool, so you'll see them again in future practice sessions.
faq_how_to_practice_q: How do I practice my words?
faq_how_to_practice_a: Tap on "Practice" from the home tab. You will go through your active words using flashcards. Swipe up to mark a word as learned or loop it to the back of the stack for more practice.
faq_reset_session_q: Can I reset my practice session?
faq_reset_session_a: Yes! After finishing all active cards, you can tap "Reset" to start practicing your words again, or fetch new practice words if in practice mode.
faq_word_selection_q: How are my words selected each day?
faq_word_selection_a: Your daily words are selected based on your learning goals and previously learned words. The app prioritizes words you haven’t mastered yet.
faq_feedback_q: How do I give feedback or report an issue?
faq_feedback_a: Use the "Feedback" button in the app to send your comments. This opens your default email app pre-filled with our support email.
faq_offline_a: Yes, most features work offline once your words are downloaded. You will need internet access to fetch new words or use the text-to-speech feature.
